finding: The KSU page header identifies Surah 108, ayah 3, and labels the location 'Page 602' within the KSU Electronic Mosshaf/Ayat project. This is the Quran/mushaf page location for the displayed verse, not a verified printed page number of a Tabari edition. Therefore previous T10–T15 checkpoint fields calling 602 a 'printed page' or 'printed_page' were inaccurate and are being corrected to 'quran_page' / KSU Quran page marker. KSU credits mosshaf.com as an upstream tafsir-content source, but that attribution still does not identify the print edition, editor, publisher, volume, or pagination used for the Tabari wording. The exact edition behind legacy source ID 310 remains unresolved.
